$comment: Merch print files only (no mockups). Trim sizes, bleed and safe areas are common vendor print areas (the same conventions as the context-ds and spyglass-ds engines): confirm with the vendor template before ordering. Layouts are in inches from the trim. Only the approved logo files are used, as drawn: brand/logo/lockup.svg (the name and 'by Agentcard', typeset from the display face) and brand/logo/mark.svg (never recolored). The brand has one ground, white, and refuses blue grounds and dark pages (brand/principles.md), so there are two variants: color (the art alone on a transparent ground, for white or light blanks) and paper (a white ground to the bleed, for printed items). Print on white or light blanks only.

slots.headline: Open router for commerce
slots.body: Buy from any online store from a single endpoint.
slots.label: agent.ts

color.description: The art alone on a transparent ground; for white or light blanks.

paper.description: A white ground to the bleed; for printed items.

items.name: T-shirt front
items.source: Common adult tee front print area: 12 by 16 in (DTG standard). Garment prints are not trimmed, so no bleed. Confirm against the vendor template.

items.name: T-shirt back
items.source: Common adult tee back print area: 12 by 16 in (DTG standard). No bleed. Confirm against the vendor template.

items.name: Hoodie front
items.source: Pullover hoodie front above the pouch pocket: 12 by 10 in is a common area. No bleed. Confirm against the vendor template.

items.name: Cap front panel
items.source: Common front embroidery area on a structured six-panel cap: 4 by 1.75 in. Thread, so no bleed and no glyph field (too fine to stitch). Confirm against the vendor template.

items.name: Tote bag
items.source: Print area on a standard 15 by 16 in canvas tote: 12 by 14 in is common. No bleed. Confirm against the vendor template.

items.name: Mug wrap, 11 oz
items.source: 11 oz mug wrap: 9 by 3.5 in is a common print area, with 0.125 in bleed for the full wrap. The lockup sits on each side of the handle. Confirm against the vendor template.

items.name: Sticker, die-cut
items.source: Die-cut sticker 3 by 3 in, the mark itself: cut along its rounded square (CutContour path in the SVG, a spot line the cutter reads; not printed), with the mark's blue carried 0.125 in past the cut. Confirm against the vendor template.

items.name: Poster, 18 by 24 in
items.source: Standard 18 by 24 in poster with 0.125 in bleed on every side and a 0.5 in safe margin. The art is the share images' hero layout at poster size. Confirm against the vendor template.
